About Swiggy
Swiggy is India's leading food delivery platform, serving 500+ cities and 200,000+ restaurant partners. Our consumer product team obsesses over every touchpoint in the ordering experience — from discovery to delivery.

Role: Product Manager — Consumer Discovery (3-6 years)

You will own Swiggy's restaurant discovery and search experience — the first thing users see when they open the app. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where a 1% improvement in conversion translates to crores in GMV.

What You'll Do
- Own the product roadmap for restaurant discovery: search, browse, recommendations, and curation
- Define and drive OKRs for discovery — conversion rate, time to order, NPS
- Work with data science team to improve ranking algorithms and personalization models
- Run A/B experiments continuously — hypothesis, design, ship, measure, learn
- Conduct user research and synthesize insights into product requirements
- Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, and ops to ship features end-to-end
- Present roadmap and results to senior leadership quarterly

What We're Looking For
- 3-6 years of product management experience, preferably in consumer internet
- Strong analytical skills — comfortable pulling SQL queries, reading dashboards, interpreting cohort data
- Experience running A/B tests — you know statistical significance, not just green/red
- Ability to write crisp, unambiguous PRDs that engineers can build from
- User empathy — you talk to real users, not just read analytics
- Strong stakeholder management — you can align cross-functional teams without authority
- MBA or engineering background preferred

Bonus Points
- Prior experience in food tech, e-commerce, or marketplace products
- Experience with recommendation systems or search products
- SQL proficiency beyond SELECT * — window functions, joins, CTEs
- Growth PM experience with funnel optimization

About Zepto
Zepto delivers groceries in 10 minutes across 10+ cities. We're rebuilding the grocery shopping experience from scratch — and we need PMs who want to move fast and break things (carefully).

Role: Associate Product Manager (0-2 years)

This is a generalist APM role. You will rotate across Zepto's core product areas — consumer app, dark store ops, catalog, and growth — before finding your home team. You'll be surrounded by ex-founders, ex-consultants, and engineers from IITs and IIMs, and you'll be expected to hold your own.

What You'll Do
- Own specific features end-to-end within your squad
- Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria
- Partner with engineers and designers daily to ship product
- Analyze data to identify opportunities and validate hypotheses
- Conduct user interviews and synthesize research into insights
- Track key metrics and report on product health
- Move fast — we ship weekly, not quarterly

What We're Looking For
- 0-2 years experience (fresher to early-career) in product, consulting, or engineering
- Strong first-principles thinking — can break down a problem from scratch
- High ownership — you own outcomes, not just tasks
- Clear communication — written and verbal; can write a tight brief
- Curiosity — you use 20+ apps and have strong opinions about what's good and bad
- Comfort with ambiguity — you don't need a playbook

Bonus Points
- Prior internship in product management or management consulting
- Technical background (engineering degree) — can converse with engineers as equals
- SQL or data analytics experience
- Prior startup or entrepreneurial experience

About Groww
Groww has taken investing from 10M to 50M+ users in 3 years. Our growth team is responsible for the engine that drives this — acquisition, activation, retention, and referral. We are one of the fastest growing fintech products in history.

Role: Growth Product Manager (3-5 years)

You will own Groww's user growth and engagement funnel — from first install to first investment to long-term investor. You will run a high-velocity experimentation machine, shipping 10+ experiments per month.

What You'll Do
- Own the full AARRR funnel for Groww: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Revenue, Referral
- Build and run a continuous experimentation roadmap with 10+ concurrent A/B tests
- Analyze cohort retention, D1/D7/D30 metrics, and identify drop-off points
- Design and optimize onboarding flows for first-time investors
- Build viral loops and referral programs that have driven Groww's organic growth
- Work with marketing team on attribution models and campaign integration
- Define north star metrics and OKRs for growth team

What We're Looking For
- 3-5 years product experience with at least 2 years in a growth or retention focused role
- Strong quantitative skills — you live in dashboards and can write SQL
- Deep knowledge of growth frameworks: AARRR, ICE, PIE, cohort analysis
- Experience running statistically rigorous A/B tests
- Understanding of user psychology and behavioral economics
- Experience with analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar)
- Ability to move fast without breaking regulatory compliance (this is fintech)

Bonus Points
- Prior growth experience in fintech, BFSI, or regulated industries
- Understanding of KYC/KRA flows and their impact on activation
- LTV modeling and payback period analysis experience
- Referral mechanics and viral loop design

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the global leader in CRM, empowering companies of every size and industry to connect with their customers. Our platform serves 150,000+ companies and is the backbone of enterprise sales, service, and marketing operations globally.

Role: Senior Product Manager — CRM Intelligence (5-8 years)

You will lead product for Salesforce's AI-powered CRM Intelligence suite — the layer that surfaces insights, forecasts, and recommendations to sales reps and managers. This product is used by enterprise sales teams at Fortune 500 companies.

What You'll Do
- Define the 3-year product vision and roadmap for CRM Intelligence features
- Conduct deep customer discovery with enterprise customers: CROs, sales ops, and front-line reps
- Work with AI/ML research teams to translate model capabilities into product value
- Define pricing and packaging strategy for intelligence features
- Enable enterprise sales team with demo assets, competitive positioning, and objection handling
- Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and sales
- Present roadmap to C-suite customers and external conferences

What We're Looking For
- 5-8 years product management experience, with 3+ years in B2B/enterprise products
- Track record of shipping 0-to-1 features in a complex enterprise environment
- Strong customer empathy for enterprise buyers — you understand procurement, compliance, security concerns
- Experience working with AI/ML teams and translating model outputs into user value
- API product experience — can define external APIs and integration patterns
- Executive-level communication skills — can present to CROs and VPs
- Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycle and CRM domain preferred

Bonus Points
- Prior CRM product experience (Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics)
- Experience with SOC2, enterprise security, and compliance requirements
- Pricing and packaging strategy experience
- MBA from a top-tier institution

About Razorpay
Razorpay's APIs power payments for 8M+ businesses in India. Our platform team builds the APIs, SDKs, and developer tools that make Razorpay the preferred payment platform for developers and product teams.

Role: Technical Product Manager — Platform APIs (3-6 years)

You will own Razorpay's core payment APIs — the products that 8M businesses use to integrate payments into their apps. Developer experience is your north star. A bad API is a customer we lose before they ever pay us.

What You'll Do
- Define API design standards, versioning policies, and deprecation strategies
- Build Razorpay's developer experience: documentation, sandbox, SDKs, and Postman collections
- Work with engineering to design new APIs for payment methods, subscriptions, and payouts
- Collect and synthesize developer feedback from support tickets, NPS surveys, and developer interviews
- Monitor API adoption metrics, SDK download trends, and integration success rates
- Create technical documentation, code samples, and integration guides
- Partner with sales engineers to enable complex enterprise integrations

What We're Looking For
- 3-6 years product management experience, ideally with at least 2 years in API/platform products
- Strong technical background — can read code, understand webhooks, debug API responses
- Deep empathy for developer users — you've integrated APIs as a developer yourself
- Experience writing technical documentation that developers actually find useful
- Payments domain knowledge — UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets, or equivalent
- Strong analytical skills — can analyze API error rates, latency distributions, adoption funnels

Bonus Points
- Prior software engineering experience (highest weight)
- PCI-DSS or payment security knowledge
- Experience building or evangelizing developer platforms
- Open-source contributions or public technical writing

About Google
Google AI is pushing the frontier of artificial intelligence research and product. From Search to Gemini to Cloud AI, we're building AI products used by billions of people and responsible for how the world experiences AI.

Role: Senior Product Manager — Gemini Consumer (5-8 years)

You will define product strategy for Gemini's consumer-facing features — the AI assistant capabilities that hundreds of millions of Google users will experience. This is one of the highest-impact PM roles in the industry right now.

What You'll Do
- Define the product vision and 2-year roadmap for Gemini consumer features
- Work directly with research teams to translate model capabilities into user-facing features
- Build robust evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, safety, and user satisfaction
- Navigate responsible AI tradeoffs — capability vs. safety, personalization vs. privacy
- Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research to understand how users interact with AI
- Drive alignment across Google's AI product portfolio (Search, Assistant, Workspace)
- Represent product at research reviews and influence model training priorities

What We're Looking For
- 5-8 years product management experience with at least 2 years in AI/ML products
- Deep technical acumen — can understand model architectures at a conceptual level, evaluate benchmarks critically
- Experience defining evaluation metrics for AI products where success is not binary
- Strong responsible AI intuition — proactively identifies failure modes, bias risks, misuse vectors
- Exceptional communication — can simplify complex AI concepts for users and executives
- Track record of shipping AI features to millions of users

Bonus Points
- Prior experience on conversational AI or LLM products
- Research background or publications in AI/NLP
- Experience with model fine-tuning, RLHF, or prompt engineering at product level
- Experience navigating regulatory environments for AI

About CRED
CRED started as a credit card bill payment app and has since launched travel, commerce, cash loans, and car management. Every new product is a 0-to-1 bet. We are building a new kind of premium financial lifestyle brand for India's creditworthy population.

Role: Senior Product Manager — New Ventures (5-8 years)

You will incubate new product lines for CRED from scratch — identifying unmet needs in CRED's 12M premium member base, building business cases, running lean experiments, and taking winning bets to full product teams.

What You'll Do
- Identify new product opportunities through member research, market analysis, and whitespace mapping
- Build and test business hypotheses using lean MVPs before committing full engineering resources
- Define go/no-go criteria for new ventures and present investment cases to leadership
- Recruit and lead small autonomous 'strike teams' of 2-4 engineers + 1 designer
- Manage P&L for incubated products through launch and initial scale
- Own the end-to-end experience — product, design, ops, and marketing for new launches
- Kill initiatives early when signals are weak; double down when signals are strong

What We're Looking For
- 5-8 years product experience with demonstrated 0-to-1 product launches
- High tolerance for ambiguity — you're energized by blank whiteboards, not paralyzed
- Strong business acumen — can model unit economics, define CAC/LTV, build P&L
- User research expertise — can run jobs-to-be-done interviews, synthesize insights quickly
- Persuasive communication — can sell a vision to leadership and recruit a team to it
- Track record of killing bad ideas as well as shipping good ones

Bonus Points
- Prior startup founding experience
- Experience building in financial services, lifestyle, or premium consumer categories
- Design sensibility — you can give meaningful design feedback
- Experience in a VC or growth equity fund as a post-MBA associate

About Juspay
Juspay is India's leading payment orchestration platform, processing $40B+ in annual payment volume for Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy, and 300+ other companies. We are the invisible infrastructure of India's digital payments ecosystem.

Role: Platform Product Manager (3-6 years)

You will own Juspay's payment orchestration API platform — the core product that enterprise clients use to route, retry, and manage payments across 100+ payment methods. Your users are CTOs, payment teams, and senior engineers at top Indian enterprises.

What You'll Do
- Define the roadmap for Juspay's orchestration APIs, dashboard, and developer tools
- Conduct discovery sessions with enterprise payment teams to understand integration pain points
- Design API schemas, webhook payloads, and error response standards
- Measure and improve developer time-to-integration (our north star: under 1 week)
- Work with solutions engineering on complex enterprise integrations
- Build self-serve capabilities to reduce dependence on manual onboarding
- Track payment success rates, failure analysis, and uptime SLAs

What We're Looking For
- 3-6 years product experience, ideally in payments or financial infrastructure
- Technical depth — comfortable reading API docs, understanding HTTP, webhooks, OAuth
- Developer empathy — you have personally integrated APIs and know the pain
- Strong analytical ability — can analyze payment funnel data, failure codes, reconciliation gaps
- Ability to manage complex enterprise relationships and competing priorities
- Comfort with regulatory requirements: RBI guidelines, PCI-DSS, UPI framework

Bonus Points
- Prior experience at a payment gateway, aggregator, or fintech
- Engineering background
- Open-source contributions to payments tooling
- Knowledge of international payment networks (Visa, Mastercard, SWIFT)
